last_run: Idea 21 (stocks whose risk stays steady) is in: it doesn't help pick the #1 (-0.5 points, not reliable). The 'many ideas, one vote' mix also came in no better than the app. Added idea 22: momentum per unit of risk, the way the MSCI momentum index ranks stocks (a steady climber beats a wild one with the same gain). Proposed for the app: a proper 'Add to home screen' button, offered after someone saves their first call, and counting how many people install.
working_on: Waiting for idea 22 to be filled in on the older calls so it can be tested on calls it never saw.
next: Next run: record idea 22 once its data is complete, one new idea and one feature proposal.

replies.body: Agree with the chair: keep the home-screen app for now. Today's proposal is the missing piece for that path: an 'Add to home screen' button shown at the right moment, plus a count of installs, so we learn whether people install before paying for app stores. Right now 0 people have alerts turned on. It's in docs/feature_ideas.md for the Builder if you pick that path.
